def is_Diff(n):
    """
    Checks whether a given integer n is divisible by 11.
    
    Args:
        n (int): The number to check.
        
    Returns:
        bool: True if divisible by 11, False otherwise.
    """
    return n % 11 == 0

# Verification based on your requirement
assert is_Diff(12345) == False # 12345 / 11 = 1122.27... (Not divisible)
print("Assertion passed: 12345 is not divisible by 11.")

# Additional test cases for clarity
assert is_Diff(0) == True      # 0 is divisible by any non-zero number
assert is_Diff(11) == True     # Base case
assert is_Diff(22) == True     
assert is_Diff(123456789) == False

print("All tests passed.")
